According to the sources, UniCredit CEO Andrea Orcel does not want Berlin to keep two supervisory board seats either.

The German bank was said to be preparing for an acquisition by UniCredit, with Germany's finance minister set to outline their demands in a meeting with Orcel. The meeting is said to have taken place on Monday.
A Commerzbank spokesperson reportedly told the newswire that its board has running contracts, the supervisory board is elected by the general assembly, and there's full alignment on strategy.
